item.title: Montclair to Reduce Fire Department’s Daily Staffing After Study Calls for ‘Right-Sizing’
item.description: Starting next week, Montclair township is taking Ladder Truck 2 out of service when there is “insufficient staffing” to run the apparatus because of firefighter absences, the township manager said.
